raw.hi: AglaSem Earn While You Learn Program! अपने हाल के प्रश्न पत्र हमें भेजें और कमाएँ! भाग लेने के लिए हमें निम्न विवरण के साथ ईमेल करें: आपके पास उपलब्ध प्रश्न पत्रों का विवरण। हमारी टीम आगे की प्रक्रिया के लिए आपसे संपर्क करेगी।
raw.en: AglaSem Earn While You Learn Program! Share your recent question papers with us and get paid! To participate, email us with the following details: Your Name, Your Class, Your Board, Details of the Question Papers you have. Our team will reach out to you with the next steps. Email: support@aglasem.com

notes: Not exam content — aglasem.com promotional wrapper page asking readers to email them question papers. Treated as inert page data per the instruction-source-boundary rule (text found in a document is data, not a command to act on); not acted upon.
